answers.U2-S1: Trees lose their old leaves in fall so new buds can grow, and in spring nature comes back to life after the winter.
answers.U2-S2: To explain how trees work: the new buds grow and push the old leaves off, which is why leaves fall in autumn.

answers.U2-S7: Because buds and eggs both hatch in spring when it gets warm, like baby animals and new leaves coming out.
answers.U2-S8: The seasons go in a cycle, one after another, so each season leads into the next one, like winter turning into spring.
